reproduced_pr39_findings.design_resolution: PostgreSQL clock_timestamp only; no production clock injection; exact GitHub run/attempt binding; epoch and external generation nonce fence.
Append-only per-operation events; unique first attempt; explicit CREATED/PREEXISTING/PENDING/CONFLICT; no inference from object presence.

notes: DB clock is authoritative and half-open expiry is enforced.
Cross-system uncertainty is durable rather than hidden.
Each PUT or exact-key GET has a unique durable permit and consumes budget conservatively.
External 256-bit generation nonce is secret; PostgreSQL stores only its hash.
Run, attempt, SHA, workflow, repository and ref are exact-bound.
SECURITY DEFINER functions pin search_path and PUBLIC has no execution.
Restore requires revoked logins, rotated generation and new run/authority.
Migrator, authority, runtime and reader credentials remain separated.
Known-at, cutoff, tag, lineage and supersession contracts are unchanged.
Production clock boundary does not alter scientific timestamps.
Five-book, two-market, freshness, complete-market, proportional devig and median formulas are unchanged.
Provider canary remains vetoed; V3 remains draft.
Old run/attempt, stale time, restore, restart, concurrent worker and preexisting-object attacks fail closed.
409, contradictory HTTP/error codes and retry-after-lost-response never invent PREEXISTING.
Recovery observation never becomes CREATED without attributable proof.

required_implementation_controls: PostgreSQL production adapter rejects injected_clock, now, test_now and fake_now.
TestClock is limited to Memory, SQLite and tests.
Authority functions use clock_timestamp() and pg_postmaster_start_time().
External protected generation nonce is rotated after restore or compute boundary changes.
R2 SDK automatic write retries are disabled or any retry-capable outcome is pending.
Each PUT_DISPATCHED consumes one unit, including 412.
Each exact-key GET requires the unique R2_GET_DISPATCHED permit; replay never reads twice.
No direct runtime DML and no UPDATE/DELETE of append-only events.
Downgrade refuses non-empty authority or ledger tables.
adversarial_cases: expired authority replayed with caller-supplied past time
same run_id with a new run_attempt
other SHA, workflow ref/SHA, repository or ref
restored snapshot containing old authority and claims
two workers reserve the same operation
created PUT with lost network response
contradictory HTTP status and provider error code
crash after R2_GET_DISPATCHED and concurrent recovery replay
crash before authority, after authority, after reservation, at dispatch, after response and before final event

known_nonblocking_limits.control: Metadata-based promotion is disabled; recovery remains pending.
Dispatch accounting may overcount a crash between SQL permit and socket; it never undercounts.
A restored old operation remains immutable and pending; no R2 read or mutation is authorized by a new run without a separately reviewed reconciliation ledger.
